coverage.facts: Shared controller definition validator rejects malformed/default/route/template structures before packaging, install or effects; contextual ValueError-compatible diagnostics preserve authored workflow/step/field/reference/correction. Supported empties and earlier feasible producers remain accepted.

Production selected-switch rendering/selection defers output availability to consumption. Source/installed route tests cover preparation/source skips, empty case/default, unknown selection and missing selected outputs while preventing untaken work.

Both connected positive scenarios call production eligibility, activation/history, review/tracking, actual post-pass-capture and guarded re-entry; historical bindings remain unchanged while current proof is validated.

Otherwise-valid controls exercise historical forgery/alteration/absence/unbinding, stale current review, unauthorized task edits, missing/wrong-branch outputs, no progress and each exhausted budget. Marker/administrative/answer/restart variants preserve counters without progress credit.

Production assignment, consequential gate, same-child relay and installation-drift controls stop safely; connected traces assert zero undeclared phases, Git, real verification or acceptance effects. Applied lifecycle readback retains receipt identity without replaying the writer and rejects changed non-roadmap evidence.

Required disposable snapshot tests compare source and installed controller/workflow bytes, paired route/definition/positive/negative outcomes and applied lifecycle readback. Current independent evidence records all three tests passed without credited skips.

Observed provenance is independently collected and checked; actual portable observation packets and sensitivity controls are validated. Source docs explain diagnostics, selected inputs, manual fallback, safe next actions and deterministic limits.

inference.basis: Observed production implementation and connected controls plus current independently reviewed passing evidence cover the roadmap outcome, scope and all 17 FR/7 SC keys; unchanged hashes permit reuse of recorded executions. This is a scoped verification recommendation, not acceptance.

prerequisite_errors.observed: Initial python:prepare failed on sandbox-denied default mise cache writes; isolated temporary MISE_CACHE_DIR rerun passed prepare/check with existing environment unchanged. Pinned Specify DNS warnings did not prevent the Python helper operations.

Attempted validate-path --kind spec-read was rejected by installed generic helper, which exposes roadmap-read, roadmap-write, adr and prd only. Exact selected spec and all witness paths were directly checked as existing contained regular files and read/hash-verified; no unsupported mode was used thereafter.

material_limitations: The installed generic delta helper observes the complete ambient HEAD-to-WORKTREE manifest; the selected review boundary is the main-retained 18-path attributable implementation packet and its immutable predecessor witnesses. Ambient governance, feedback, historical run records and future-policy findings outside that boundary are recorded as exclusions; no repository-wide absence claim is made.

Current passing validation is retained independent evidence bound to unchanged source/test hashes, not new suite execution by this debrief. Historical sandbox socket failures are preserved and were resolved by the existing approved loopback rerun.

Deterministic simulated dispatch establishes regression behavior and representative disposable source/installed parity. Live effective agent settings, Linux execution, publication, stock compatibility, adoption, release and acceptance are not established.
Historical F023-PASS6-ACTIVATION-COVERAGE supporting-test exception remains disclosed in the prior completion evidence; this review does not reconstruct historic authority.

No configured ADR directory is present and no matched-entry ADR/PRD pointer requires external resolution. No independent extension source is changed. The installed package contains no shared debrief report template; required skill provenance fields are explicitly supplied here.
